summary: Snapshot sheet used by CS leads to orchestrate renewals for the next 120 days. Includes ARR, probability, key risks, and next steps. This doc is intentionally a lean single-tab workbench for weekly standups; handoff notes included in Status Notes column.
assumptions_and_rules: Probability is CS-assigned based on engagement, legal posture, and executive alignment
Days to Renew = (Contract End - today) approximated at snapshot date
Upsell Opportunity is an estimate based on product fit and QBR conversations
recommended_play_actions: >0.8 probability: standard renewal play (renewal proposal + PO)
0.5-0.8: Value reinforcement + exec alignment + pricing flexibility
<0.5: Risk remediation play — allocate solutions engineering + procurement support
